Package main.java.progOO2.p19

package main.java.progOO2.p19

Programming Object Oriented II: Program Collection

This package demonstrates how to store objects in a list, filter them by attributes, and display results based on user input. The exercise uses television programs as the main example.

Classes:

  • TelevisionProgram represents a TV program with a name and duration. It also includes a small utility method isAwesome() that checks if the program name contains "MasterChef".
  • ProgramCollection contains the main method. It reads program data (name, duration) from the user, stores them in an ArrayList, and prints only those whose duration is within the user-specified maximum.

Key learning goals:

  • Collections: Managing objects inside an ArrayList.
  • User input: Reading structured input to create objects.
  • Filtering: Printing only objects that satisfy a condition (max duration).
  • Encapsulation: Keeping fields private and providing getters.
  • Utility methods: Demonstrating extra behavior with isAwesome().

This exercise strengthens the ability to design data classes and use collections to filter and process information interactively.
